title: PinIt
description: A simple mod that allows you to pin recipes in the recipe book and slots in your inventory.
body:
![pinit title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6b2400ea5f68a804d12159ce437aa501cbfdc6a.png) ![divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97667c6a407865da24915c7252be40556c32ad52.png) **PinIt** is a simple mod that lets you pin recipes in the vanilla recipe book, keeping them on the first page for quick access. You can also pin up to **9 inventory slots**, allowing you to see the contents of those slots without opening your inventory. By default, pinned slots show the item count of that specific slot, but you can enable a setting to instead count **all items of the same type** across your entire inventory. PinIt also lets you customize the **shape and color** of pins, and you can independently enable or disable **recipe pinning** and **slot pinning**. if you find any issues with the mod you can report them on my **[Discord Server](https://discord.gg/3Cx2NHdpef)** ***
Translation **The mod currently supports these languages:** - **_English_** _(DomixCZE)_ - **_Czech_** _(DomixCZE)_ - **_Croatian_** _(Pattot)_
